displayName: llm-metrics collector: error event or failed task

documentation.content: The scheduled OpenAI collector (Cloud Run Job llm-metrics-collector) logged an ERROR event (config_refused, late_start, claim_failed, clock_skew, expired_before_call, provider_rejected, not_persisted) or a task failed. No provider request is ever retried. Check: gcloud logging read for the execution, then run the collector audit (scripts/gcp/023_collector.sh audit). Emergency stop: scripts/gcp/023_collector.sh stop.
